contract.train: TRAIN_offpolicy_repair_stream.jsonl ONLY. Full historical source prefixes plus forced wrong material paint (weight=0), followed by actual host-replayed ERASE/corrected PAINT/STOP (weight>0).
contract.model_visible: Only ordered steps[].input + past observed actions. All source identities, outcomes and forks are in EVALUATOR_ONLY sidecars; never pass them to a policy.
contract.intervention: Deliberately WRONG paint action, host-executed and loss-masked, not a teacher-supervision target. Keep model recurrent state across the action; do not add evaluator metadata.
contract.dev: DEV_EVALUATOR_ONLY_offpolicy_repair_stream.jsonl for development scoring; no training or hyperparameter optimization.
contract.heldout: HELDOUT_EVALUATOR_ONLY_offpolicy_repair_stream.jsonl sealed; no training, selection or prompt tuning.
contract.scope: Only recoverable surface-B wrong-paint episodes become trainable complete episodes. Terminal surface-A wrong-paints form evaluator-only failure-control certificates, NOT training examples or recoveries.
contract.evaluation: Score off-policy ERASE->correct PAINT->STOP recovery separately from original correct-paint pair accuracy and whole-episode autonomous terminal success. This dataset is teacher-forced and synthetic.
contract.split: Preserve parent v56 world geometry ownership; cross-version worlds must remain grouped by source split.
contract.weights: All original source weights retained; intervention zero; recovery ERASE and corrected PAINT receive focus_loss_weight=6; terminal STOP=1. No evaluator label exposed.

limitations: Recovery uses v51 symbolic oracle after a forced wrong action and therefore is a demonstration, not autonomous learned policy recovery.
v53 synthetic host makes A material errors terminal while B errors are recoverable; this is not a native CyberSand rule.
Source-selected v56 worlds and scripted preludes still admit simple parsers and do not constitute new geometry.
No pinned target SLM weights updated, CPU neural latency/RSS, native CyberSand playback or immutable Actions corpus artifacts.
